meta.description: Predicted vs realized annualized volatility per allocation, the data behind assets/estimation_vs_evaluation_vol.png. Predicted = allocations.predicted_vol: sqrt(252 * w' Cov w) with Cov the daily-return covariance of the estimation window 2019-01-01 to 2022-12-31. Realized = metrics.annualized_vol: sample std of the allocation's daily gross returns over the evaluation window 2023-2024, times sqrt(252).
meta.units: decimal fraction per year (0.137 = 13.7 percent), 4 decimal places
